name: update_user_details, add_new_user
description: Verify Thomas Green (ID 1) is active and the new agent Sarah Connor (ID 803, role 'agent') was successfully created.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE (user_id = 1 AND active = 1) OR (user_id = 803 AND first_name = 'Sarah' AND last_name = 'Connor' AND role = 'agent');

name: add_new_product
description: Verify the new product 'Quantum Firewall 5000' was created as active hardware (product_id 241).

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE product_id = 241 AND name = 'Quantum Firewall 5000' AND category = 'hardware' AND lifecycle_state = 'active';

name: add_new_group_member
description: Verify the new agent (user_id 803) was successfully added to the correct support group (group_id 1).

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE group_id = 1 AND user_id = 803;

name: create_knowledge
description: Verify the knowledge article (KB-0000370) related to the new product (product_id 241) and owned by the new agent (owner_id 803) exists in draft state.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge WHERE kb_number = 'KB000370' AND product_id = 241 AND owner_id = 803 AND state = 'draft';

name: find_user_group
description: Confirm the target support group (ID 1) is active and correctly classified as 'support' type.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group WHERE group_id = 1 AND name = 'CSM Tier 1 Support' AND type = 'support' AND active = 1;
